name: [☀️] Singing Monsters 3D
desc:
🎤 Sing, explore, and breed monsters in Monster World 3D!

🏝️ Every island has its own sound! Explore them all to hear how your monsters sing differently on each one!

🧬 Breed monsters you've unlocked using structures found on the islands to discover new species! including rare and epic forms!

🎵 Sing as your monsters to earn coins, and collect traits that boost their abilities and coins!

🏆 Collect badges and hunt down every monster to complete your collection!
💎 Premium Players get a 1.4x Coin Boost!!
